mapper.sql: patient_id, full_name, gender, birth_date, phone, email, address, wx_openid, created_date, note, emergency_contact_name, emergency_contact_phone
mapper.select: SELECT pa.record_id, pa.patient_id, pa.allergen_id, pa.severity, pa.reaction, pa.first_record_date, a.allergen_name, a.category AS allergen_category FROM patient_allergy pa JOIN allergen a ON a.allergen_id = pa.allergen_id WHERE pa.patient_id = #{patientId} ORDER BY pa.record_id
SELECT allergen_id, allergen_name, category, description FROM allergen ORDER BY allergen_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO patient (full_name, gender, birth_date, phone, email, address, wx_openid, created_date, note, emergency_contact_name, emergency_contact_phone) VALUES (#{fullName}, #{gender}, #{birthDate}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{address}, #{wxOpenid}, #{createdDate}, #{note}, #{emergencyContactName}, #{emergencyContactPhone})
INSERT INTO patient_allergy (patient_id, allergen_id, severity, reaction, first_record_date) VALUES (#{patientId}, #{allergenId}, #{severity}, #{reaction}, #{firstRecordDate})
